observations: Photo 0 shows two black PlayStation controllers and a PS4 game case for 'Marvel Spider-Man: Miles Morales' on a black surface with a PlayStation logo.
Photo 1 shows the bottom of a black rectangular device with the PlayStation logo and four corner symbols (triangle, X, square, circle) — consistent with a PS4 Slim console.
Photo 2 shows the top of the same black rectangular device with the PlayStation logo, appearing dusty and scratched.
The console is not shown from the front or side, so ports, power button, or model label are not visible.
The controllers show wear: one has a cracked or damaged touchpad area, and both have visible dirt and grime.
The game case is for a PS4 title, but it is not clear if it is included or just for display.

claims.claim: Used PlayStation 4 Slim in excellent working condition
claims.evidence: Photos show the console and controllers, but no proof of functionality. The controllers show visible damage (cracked touchpad).
No video or demonstration of the console powering on, loading games, or connecting to peripherals. No front or side view to check ports or power button.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or have internal damage
risks.proof: Video showing the console powering on, booting up, and playing a game.

risks.risk: Controllers may be non-functional or have damaged components (e.g., cracked touchpad)
risks.proof: Video showing both controllers connecting to the console and responding to inputs.
risks.if_unproven: priced as one or both controllers non-functional

risks.risk: Console may have a faulty disc drive or HDMI port
risks.proof: Video showing a game disc being inserted and played, and HDMI output to a TV or monitor.
risks.if_unproven: priced as disc drive or HDMI port faulty

risks.risk: Console may be stolen or have a blacklisted serial number
risks.proof: Photo of the serial number on the bottom of the console (if visible) or a screenshot from the console's settings showing the serial number.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially stolen or blacklisted

proof_requests: Video showing the console powering on, booting up, and playing a game.
Video showing both controllers connecting and working with the console.
Photo of the front or side of the console showing ports and power button.
Photo of the serial number on the bottom of the console.
response.reason: The console is identifiable as a PS4 Slim by its shape and logo, but there is no proof of functionality. The controllers show visible damage, and the console’s condition is unknown without seeing ports or a power-on demonstration. Without proof, it cannot be priced reliably.
